在未来的某个世界，人类已全面撤出太阳系。地球和月球基地上，留守着克隆人和遵循机器: In a future world, humanity has withdrawn from the solar system. Earth and the Moon are left to clones and generations of robots bound by the Three Laws of Robotics. With resources running out and conflicts irreconcilable, a robot government on the Moon declares war on the clones. It invokes rights granted by its creators and denounces the clone government’s rule. As the monument to the Three Laws falls, the Earth–Moon war begins. Then Nemesis, a wanderer and gambler from a distant human civilization, unexpectedly returns to humanity’s birthplace aboard his Red Ghost.
这篇文章囊括了我对中文播客的绝大部分经验和看法。也成为一份早期播客圈的知识备份。: This essay gathers most of my experience with and thoughts on Chinese podcasts. It also became a record of the early podcast community. Xioayuzhou CEO Kyth and SSPAI CEO Laomai shared and recommended it; several major media outlets later cited it.
在 2025 年末，我一个人去新疆玩了 24 天，辗转南疆北疆，去了乌鲁木齐、吐: At the end of 2025, I traveled alone through Xinjiang for 24 days, across both its northern and southern regions. I visited Urumqi, Turpan, Fuyun, Altay, Shache, Kashgar, Tashkurgan, Aksu, Yining and Bole. I rode the snowfield train at Koktokay, passed cattle, sheep and horses in winter’s wilderness, and watched sunset gild Bogda Peak. There were snow-covered pines, yaks on frozen White Sand Lake, the silent Muztagh Ata, old homes in Kashgar, and the Karakoram closing off the road like a great wall. Birds shook water from their feathers in Ili’s wetlands; sunset colored Sayram Lake and the mountains. Ibex grazed in a high mountain wind. Xinjiang asks for no explanation. Breathing is enough. Camels barely glance at you; horses simply neigh. Snow falls, flowers bloom, mountains stand, water stays blue, and the universe goes on.
我的绝大多数软件技术都是自学，依托于早期互联网的开源分享精神，从许多大佬的教程中: Most of my software skills are self-taught, thanks to the sharing spirit of the early internet and the tutorials of generous creators. Keynote may be the most important software in my life, and the one I have studied most deeply. To give something back to that spirit, I turned my ideas and methods into tutorials.

二百五十年前，歌德写等级森严下的德国社会里，少年维特挫折的爱情和事业，以及诸多的: Two hundred and fifty years ago, Goethe wrote about young Werther’s frustrated love and career in Germany’s rigid social order. Are these Werther’s sorrows, or the sorrows of youth? I still do not know. Goethe was writing about himself. Perhaps I was too. Two centuries later, the sorrow continues.

创作是世界上最美好的事: Creating is the most beautiful thing in the world
我是拐子狼。这个名称用了很久，最早叫「瘸狼唱残月」，瘸狼和残月就是我和世界，我和: I’m Guaizilang. I have used this name for a long time. My earliest name was “A Lame Wolf Sings to the Waning Moon.” The wolf and the moon are me and the world. Neither of us is perfect, but the act of “singing” enriches us both and gives meaning to each other’s existence. That is what creating means to me.

醒来就能望见远处的雪山。富蕴四面都是山，冰雪流水的河流冷冽湍急，人们行走得小心又: Wake up and you can see the snowy mountains in the distance. Mountains surround Fuyun. Its rivers of ice and meltwater are cold and swift; people walk carefully, yet firmly. The sky is white, the mountains are white, and the half-frozen river shines brightly too. Only the town carries a little color, and people’s hearts grow busy with everyday errands. Imagine a bonfire burning on the snowfield… That light is Fuyun. Xinjiang is so vast that it has room for everything. It is a place without noise, a place that offers no lectures. There, breathing is enough. A camel will not give you a second glance; a horse simply neighs. Snow falls, flowers bloom, mountains stand, lakes are blue, and the universe turns on its own.
